## Core stack

Frontend: Next.js, React, React Native (Expo), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
Backend: Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, REST APIs
Data: PostgreSQL, Neon, Supabase, MongoDB, Firebase, SQLite
AI: OpenAI Agents SDK, Anthropic, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP servers, RAG, LiveKit
Desktop: Rust, Tauri v2
Infra: Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud, Vercel, Cloudflare R2

## Featured case studies

- [BarberBook](https://www.mromankhan.com/projects/barberbook):
  REPLACED: a front desk answering calls, a paper walk-in register, reminder calls made
  by hand, and revenue tracked from memory.
  Multi-tenant B2B SaaS for barbershop booking and queue management. Real-time availability engine that makes
  double-bookings impossible, live walk-in queue over Pusher WebSockets, automated
  WhatsApp → SMS → email reminders that cut no-shows by up to 40%, subscription billing
  and revenue analytics. Installable PWA. Solo full-stack build.
  Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, Prisma, PostgreSQL (Neon),
  Better Auth, Pusher, Twilio, Resend. Live: https://barber-book-beryl.vercel.app

- [FBR Digital Invoice App](https://www.mromankhan.com/projects/fbr-invoice-app):
  REPLACED: invoices typed into spreadsheets, tax worked out by hand, and every record
  re-keyed into the FBR portal.
  Government-compliant (Pakistan FBR) offline-first desktop invoicing software.
  Validate-then-post gateway handshake, per-invoice tax snapshots, FBR-spec QR codes,
  print-ready PDF export. Originally built in Electron; rebuilt in Rust/Tauri after the
  client found the ~300 MB install too heavy, cutting it to ~12 MB with an identical UI.
  Sole engineer on both versions. AES-256-GCM encrypted local SQLite, secrets
  bound to the machine via Windows Credential Manager. Sole engineer.
  Stack: Tauri v2 (Rust), React 18, TypeScript, Vite, SQLite, React Query, Zod.

- [AsianInspection Chat](https://www.mromankhan.com/projects/asianinspection-chat):
  REPLACED: staff coordinating on personal WhatsApp accounts, with no audit trail and no
  admin visibility.
  WhatsApp-class private company messenger. Real-time DMs and groups, read receipts,
  typing and presence, voice/image/video over Cloudflare R2. True offline-first with a
  persistent outbox, SQLite history and FTS5 search. Append-only messages enforced by
  Postgres Row-Level Security for full auditability, plus an admin monitoring console.
  Sole mobile and backend engineer.
  Stack: React Native 0.85, Expo SDK 56, TypeScript, Supabase, Cloudflare R2, expo-sqlite.

## Services

1. Booking & Operations SaaS: multi-tenant platforms with real-time availability or
   queue engines, role-based access, subscription billing and analytics. 4–8 weeks.
2. Agentic AI Workflows & MCP Integration: LangGraph / OpenAI Agents SDK workflows,
   custom MCP servers, RAG over client data, human-in-the-loop checkpoints. 2–5 weeks.
3. Voice AI Agents: LiveKit + WebRTC pipelines, Twilio/SIP telephony, STT → LLM → TTS
   orchestration with backend tools and transcripts. 3–6 weeks.
4. Offline-First Desktop Software: Tauri v2 (Rust) Windows apps, encrypted local
   databases, gateway integrations, print-ready PDF export. 4–8 weeks.
5. Cross-Platform Mobile Apps: React Native + Expo, Supabase/Postgres with Row-Level
   Security, offline-first storage and search, admin console. 5–10 weeks.
6. Full Stack MVP for Founders: Next.js interface, FastAPI/Next.js API, PostgreSQL,
   auth, payments, deployment and handover. 3–6 weeks.

Details: https://www.mromankhan.com/services

Send a short brief with the business problem, who uses the system, and which tools or
data it must connect to. You get the technical approach, scope and a realistic timeline
back before any commitment.
